Mike Small threw a pb in the Hammer and is nudging the Club record. But top honours go to our 800m men who placed 4 in the first 5 with Richard O'Hara taking a big slice off his pb as too did new member Phil Walker.
Mike Small finished 2nd in the Hammer behind Chris Black. Ken and Abi again won the Discus and Phil Lovell easily won the Vault with another fine display.

No, you're not seeing things! It's Ken to Abi in the 4x1 - lane 2 at Battersea will never be the same again as about 8 hundredweight of throwing power dented the track in a semi serious, sorry make that deadly serious relay! The changeover at the bottom bend involved Mike Small and Vince Cornibert.
The throwers again excelled with Mike Small scoring 15 points and Snowy Brooks was only a metre or so shy of his best ever Discus throw set some 8 years ago.
Needless to say it was the 'A' team members who turned out through the season who provided the best quality performances and mention must once again be made of the support and efforts of Mike Small.
